text: OVERDOSAGE An overdosage of PROGLYCEM causes marked hyperglycemia which may be associated with ketoacidosis. Because of the diazoxide’s long half-life (approximately 30 hours), the symptoms of overdosage require prolonged surveillance for periods up to 7 days until the blood glucose level stabilizes within the normal range. One investigator reported successful lowering of diazoxide blood levels by peritoneal dialysis in one patient and by hemodialysis in another.
